description: Gartner, Inc. delivers actionable, objective business and technology insights that drive smarter decisions and stronger performance on an organization's mission-critical priorities, and is a trusted advisor and an objective resource for over 13,000 enterprises in approximately 90 countries and territories across every major function, geography, industry and sector. It delivers its products and services globally through three reportable segments, Business and Technology Insights, Conferences and Consulting, and in the second quarter of 2025 it renamed its segment previously referred to as Research to Business and Technology Insights to reflect the nature of the value it provides to clients, while in the third quarter of 2025 it concluded that Gartner Digital Markets was an operating segment that does not meet the criteria of a reportable segment, so Digital Markets results are now included in Other.
